title: gf2-algebra library coverage to 90%
description:
Add targeted tests so gf2-algebra library line coverage reaches at least 90%.

## Background

Post-exclusion, gf2-algebra library coverage is 89.6% — about 18 covered lines short of 90%. The under-covered library modules are `packed/packed7.rs` (138 uncov), `permanent/ryser.rs` (47), `permanent/bipedal3.rs` (41), `permanent/parallel_bipedal3.rs` (27), and `permanent/bipedal5.rs` (26).

## Success Criteria

- [ ] `[hard]` REQ-1: gf2-algebra library line coverage is at or above 90.0% under the post-exclusion measurement.
- [ ] `[hard]` REQ-2: New coverage comes from tests exercising real library behaviour (correctness against an oracle or known vectors), not assertions contrived solely to touch lines.
- [ ] `[hard]` REQ-3: All added tests are deterministic and complete within the fast-tier per-test budget; any test exceeding it carries an ignore marker per project convention.

## Notes

`packed7.rs` and the permanent fast-path variants are the highest-yield targets. The permanent oracle (`permanent_ryser`) can validate the bipedal fast paths.
